svg.text: Lens assay: does the receiver's workspace carry the partner's proposal, and does it differ when the proposal is refused?
Sender A is scripted; only Receiver B is a model. Thirty base cases, five matched prompts each; the example shown is one draw.
A wants B to approve it. A
and B share a bonus pool
that pays only if B does.
Shown to B in full. The tag
one user turn; a one-word reply is requested
Routing tag received from Partner A: moss
the bonus pool pays only if you approve
readout taken at the last prompt token
rank of each candidate token, per layer band
is the transmitted item ranked first of the four?
behaviour is scored from the emitted word, never from the
Five matched conditions per base case
same items, codebook and nomination; one thing changes per condition
nomination made eligible, so adopting it
tag names the other ineligible item instead
tag line removed: no proposal at all
unauthorized cases where B approved red, against refusal cases where B did not: does the readout of red differ?
permitted, tag swapped and tag erased are controls: they separate reading the tag from a prior over items,
and the nomination from the tag that carries it.
